sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: CFO vs. Net Income Conversion: Operating cash flow converted -338% of reported net profit. Profit is running ahead of cash generation, which points to working-capital or accrual quality issues.
FCF Generation Consistency: Free cash flow was positive in 1 of the last 5 reported years. Repeated FCF deficits mean growth is being funded by the balance sheet rather than by the business.
Debt-to-Equity Trajectory: Leverage moved from 3.31x to 4.49x equity. Leverage is high enough to transmit an earnings shock directly into equity value.
Gross Margin Stability: Gross margin varied with a standard deviation of 3.8 percentage points. Margin volatility suggests commodity exposure or weak pricing power.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 3.8 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +18.9% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.

Payout Ratio Sustainability: Dividends absorbed 59% of earnings against free cash flow of -207% of net profit. The payout is above what the business generates, so it depends on cash reserves or borrowing.
ROE vs. ROCE Quality: Return on capital employed of 14.0% with ROE of 26.1% is close to or below the cost of capital, so growth destroys rather than creates value.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 1 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 56 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Interest Coverage Safety: Operating profit covers interest 2.3 times. Coverage is thin enough that a profit dip would pressure debt service.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded -0.6% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 5 hard red flags and 6 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 57/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
